body:
I've done a lot of research into this combination
.
I get the mimosa and rue blend them with a little water this creates a shredded woody mix. Now I drink the excess liquid
I like to think the body sees it as a death poison after about 5 minuets I'm sick, very sick, but I dont die. Now after the norsia passes I get a spoon and eat the shredded fibres with the smashed seeds, wash it down with water
.
After about ten minuets I will start to feel it the trip will last about 7 hours with a visual peak lasting about an hour and a half. This is by far the most economical way to do it.
After about an hour I'm hit with emotions tears well up in my eyes and I cry, after crying I feel so much better, then the giggles kick in and the contentment I'm lieing on the bed on my own listening to techno its like I'm being hugged by someone I love
its like I'm being hugged by someone I love
.
The contentment and joy is all consuming at times I drift out of conciousness into my daydreams. By about 2 hours into the trip I'm god a telepathic vampire, mind blowing stuff.
Actually just eating the stuff gives me very very strong trips on just a very small amounts. Infusions are pointless
.
